title: Seeing Through the Brain: New Insights from Decoding Visual Stimuli with fMRI

layout.note: Three full-width bands split by grey dashed rules. Top: two tinted regions read right to left (attribute/relationship search, then structured description generation). Middle: a 'Training' strip whose two right-hand boxes open through hatched wedges into a detail row (fMRI-to-text projection, predicted description, structured description box). Bottom: 'Inference' strip left to right ending in a tinted generation region and the output photo.

lesson: Open two boxes of a slim training strip into a detail row with hatched wedges, and carry one running example with per-object colours through every band so the same instance can be followed from training to inference.
